body:
At about 12pm I took the 1800mg of Lyrica. At about 2pm it started hitting hard, I felt very energetic. My caseworker had come to my apartment to help me clean my apartment, and we got a ton done due to my energy.
At about 5:30pm my dad took me to dinner, I picked up an energy drink that had 160mg of caffeine, once we got to the restaurant, I was starting to feel SUPER derpy. Before we ate I took 100mg of cannibis via an edible.
Then at about the end of our meal, the cannibis kicked in, because my stomach was empty. The Restaurant was packed, so it took awhile to get a machine. I was starting to go in and out of reality at that table. But I'm a good actor, I know how to act sober.
Now I'm going to my dad's house for the weekend, and I'm ascending while listening to music on Spotify. The car ride home was heavenly, nice backgrounds, great music, feeling great.
One of the best experiences I've ever had with substances.
NOTE: Please do not take the dose I did with pregablin. At max 600mg. I only took more due to my weight and digestive issues related to absorbing medicine.
